command:
set -eu; echo UNITS; systemctl --user cat frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/(TOKEN|KEY|SECRET)=[^[:space:]"]+/(REDACTED_SECRET)=REDACTED/g'; echo DROPINS; systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p DropInPaths -p FragmentPath --value 2>/dev/null; echo ENV_FILES; grep -RIl --exclude='*.pyc' -E 'FRANK_VOICE_BROKER_TOKEN|FRANK_VOICE_BROKER_GABRIEL_TOKEN' "$HOME/.config/systemd/user" "$HOME/.config/frankenstein" "$HOME/.config/omega" 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true; echo ENV_NAMES; systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p Environment --value 2>/dev/null | tr ' ' '
' | sed -E 's/=.*$/=<redacted>/' | grep -E 'FRANK_VOICE|LOCAL_BRIDGE|BROKER' || true
